query:
UPDATE measurements
        SET measurement_date = $2,
            front_height = $3::float8, back_height = $4::float8,
            chest = $5::float8, waist = $6::float8,
            hip = $7::float8, shoulder = $8::float8,
            shoulder_down = $9::float8, sleeve_length = $10::float8,
            neck_size = $11::float8, open_hand = $12::float8,
            open_hand_folding = $13::float8, chest_up = $14::float8,
            cuff_width = $15::float8, cuff_size = $16::float8,
            neck_width = $17::float8,
            armhole = $18::float8, fo_width = $19::float8,
            fo = $20::float8,
            bottom = $21::float8, bottom_fold = $22::float8,
            full_body = $23::float8,
            sleeve_half = $24::float8, open_fold = $25::float8,
            front_pocket_length = $26::float8,
            front_pocket_length_by_width = $27,
            side_pocket = $28::float8,
            side_pocket_length_by_width = $29,
            mobile_pocket_length_by_width = $30,
            type = $31, fit = $32
        WHERE id = $1
